questions.question: Which jobs actually lost money?

answer.answer: Three jobs lost money based on contract value minus recorded labor and material costs: Buttercup Vale Wind Turbine Base (P03), £20,320 loss; Sprout's Scarecrow Workshop (P04), £1,220 loss; and Kipper's Cat Flap (P10), £1,166.50 loss.
answer.sql:
WITH labor AS (
 SELECT w.project_id, SUM(w.hours*c.hourly_rate_gbp) AS labor_cost_gbp
 FROM site.work_logs w JOIN site.crew c ON c.crew_id=w.crew_id
 GROUP BY w.project_id
), materials AS (
 SELECT project_id, SUM(quantity*unit_cost_gbp) AS material_cost_gbp
 FROM site.material_orders
 GROUP BY project_id
)
SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.client_name, p.contract_value_gbp,
       COALESCE(l.labor_cost_gbp,0) AS labor_cost_gbp,
       COALESCE(m.material_cost_gbp,0) AS material_cost_gbp,
       p.contract_value_gbp-COALESCE(l.labor_cost_gbp,0)-COALESCE(m.material_cost_gbp,0) AS profit_gbp
FROM site.projects p
LEFT JOIN labor l USING(project_id)
LEFT JOIN materials m USING(project_id)
WHERE p.contract_value_gbp-COALESCE(l.labor_cost_gbp,0)-COALESCE(m.material_cost_gbp,0)<0
ORDER BY profit_gbp, p.project_id
assumptions: Profit is contract value minus recorded labor cost (logged hours × crew hourly rate) and material cost (ordered quantity × unit cost).
Missing labor or material records count as zero; other costs and revenue adjustments are not included.

answer.answer: Three jobs had negative gross margin: Buttercup Vale Wind Turbine Base (£6,360 loss), Kipper's Cat Flap (£646.50 loss), and Sprout's Scarecrow Workshop (£180 loss).
answer.sql:
WITH job_margin_components AS (
  SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.contract_value_gbp AS amount_gbp
  FROM site.projects p
  WHERE p.status <> 'cancelled'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, -SUM(w.hours * c.hourly_rate_gbp) AS amount_gbp
  FROM site.work_logs w
  JOIN site.crew c ON c.crew_id = w.crew_id
  JOIN site.projects p ON p.project_id = w.project_id
  WHERE p.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, -SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_cost_gbp) AS amount_gbp
  FROM site.material_orders o
  JOIN site.projects p ON p.project_id = o.project_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND p.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name
)
SELECT project_id, project_name, ROUND(SUM(amount_gbp), 2) AS gross_margin_gbp
FROM job_margin_components
GROUP BY project_id, project_name
HAVING SUM(amount_gbp) < 0
ORDER BY SUM(amount_gbp) ASC;
assumptions: “Lost money” means negative Gross Margin: contract value minus labour cost (including rework) and delivered material cost.
Cancelled projects are excluded per the Gross Margin definition.
